headline: Gold, factories and millions. How Batken plans to change by 2030
summary: Batken region in Kyrgyzstan plans to build new industrial enterprises, develop a gold deposit, expand irrigated farmland and grow tourism by 2030.
why: Regional industrial and mining plans indicate where future investment, resource output and agricultural capacity in Kyrgyzstan may grow.
original_headline: Золото, заводы и миллионы. Как собираются изменить Баткен до 2030 года
